definition.name: One normal C build and five diagnostic observations

steps.name: Fetch exact unchanged native source object
Check source-only minimal and original diagnostic controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_thread_minimal tools.tests.test_c_thread_prefix -v

steps.name: Authenticate all five unchanged native products
Install only normal captured C compiler prerequisites
steps.run:
python3 -B tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-minimal-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-minimal-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Build one diagnostic component and observe exactly five calls
Retain bounded public source, build, call and cleanup observations

with.name: c-thread-minimal-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/controls/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/commands/logs/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/application/src/main.c
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/application/wit/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/build/logs/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/c-thread-minimal/build/wit/**

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
